name: Prompts.chat
description: Proxy server that forwards requests to the prompts.chat API, providing access to a curated collection of prompts with search and filtering capabilities by keyword, type, category, and tag.

tools.name: search_prompts
tools.title: Search Prompts
tools.description: Search for AI prompts by keyword. Returns matching prompts with title, description, content, author, category, and tags. Use this to discover prompts for various AI tasks like coding, writing, analysis, and more.

query.description: Search query to find relevant prompts

limit.description: Maximum number of prompts to return (default 10, max 50)

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.title: Get Prompt
tools.description: Get a prompt by ID and optionally fill in its variables. If the prompt contains template variables (like {{variable}}), you will be asked to provide values for them.

id.description: The ID of the prompt to retrieve

fill_variables.description: If true and the prompt has template variables, triggers interactive variable filling. Default false â returns raw prompt with variable metadata.

tools.name: save_prompt
tools.title: Save Prompt
tools.description: Save a new prompt to your prompts.chat account. Requires API key authentication. Prompts are private by default unless configured otherwise in settings.

content.description: The prompt content. Can include variables like ${variable} or ${variable:default}

tags.description: Optional array of tag names (will be created if they don't exist)

isPrivate.description: Whether the prompt is private (default: uses your account setting)

tools.name: improve_prompt
tools.title: Improve Prompt
tools.description: Transform a basic prompt into a well-structured, comprehensive prompt using AI. Optionally searches for similar prompts for inspiration. Supports different output types (text, image, video, sound) and formats (text, JSON, YAML).

outputType.description: Content type: text, image, video, or sound

outputFormat.description: Response format: text, structured_json, or structured_yaml

tools.name: save_skill
tools.title: Save Skill
tools.description: Save a new Agent Skill to your prompts.chat account. Skills are multi-file prompts that can include SKILL.md (required), reference docs, scripts, and configuration files. Requires API key authentication. If the file contents are too long, first save the SKILL.md only, with no other files. Then call add_file_to_skill tool per file.

description.description: Description of what the skill does

files.description: Array of files. Must include SKILL.md as the main skill file.

isPrivate.description: Whether the skill is private (default: uses your account setting)

tools.name: add_file_to_skill
tools.title: Add File to Skill
tools.description: Add a new file to an existing Agent Skill. Use this to add reference docs, scripts, or configuration files to a skill you own.

skillId.description: The ID of the skill to add the file to

tools.name: update_skill_file
tools.title: Update Skill File
tools.description: Update an existing file in an Agent Skill. Use this to modify reference docs, scripts, configuration files, or SKILL.md content.

skillId.description: The ID of the skill containing the file

tools.name: remove_file_from_skill
tools.title: Remove File from Skill
tools.description: Remove a file from an existing Agent Skill. Cannot remove SKILL.md as it is required.

skillId.description: The ID of the skill to remove the file from

tools.name: get_skill
tools.title: Get Skill
tools.description: Get an Agent Skill by ID, including all its files (SKILL.md, reference docs, scripts, etc.). Returns the skill metadata and file contents. Save to .claude/skills/{slug}/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/{slug}/[other files] structure if user asks to download.

id.description: The ID of the skill to retrieve

tools.name: search_skills
tools.title: Search Skills
tools.description: Search for Agent Skills by keyword. Returns matching skills with title, description, author, and file list. Use this to discover reusable AI agent capabilities for coding, analysis, automation, and more.

query.description: Search query to find relevant skills

limit.description: Maximum number of skills to return (default 10, max 50)
